title: A brush for the scholar
blurb: An old scholar at 国子监 wants a good brush to write with again.
lead: An old scholar at 国子监 looks at his worn-out brush.

steps.now: The old scholar at 国子监 wants a writing brush 毛笔. The bookshop on 王府井 sells them.
steps.past: Bought a writing brush at the 王府井 bookshop.

steps.now: Bring the brush to the scholar at 国子监.
steps.past: Brought the scholar his new brush.

title: 《孔乙己》 — the character 回
blurb: Like 孔乙己 in the old story, a scholar knows four ways to write 回 and wants to see yours.
lead: A scholar in the Academy courtyard mutters about the character 回.
